$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (document-generation-vendor-adapter). Declares the `documentGenerationJob` schema, one row per render integriq takes from filinq, and seeds two dormant vendor sources (SmartDocuments, Xential) in mock mode so the whole path is walkable without a licence. The job deliberately carries a hash of the merge data and never the data: the merge data of a beschikking is the case, and integriq is not where a second copy of the case belongs. `unreachableSince` is kept apart from `lastError` on purpose: a vendor nobody could reach has not refused anything, and the two must be tellable apart without reading prose. Does NOT edit lib/Settings/integriq_register.json, whose declared schema count is asserted by tests/Unit/Settings/RegisterDescriptorTest.php.

documentGenerationJob.title: Document generation job
documentGenerationJob.summary: One render asked of a vendor document generation service
documentGenerationJob.description: One row per render integriq takes on filinq's behalf. See openspec/changes/document-generation-vendor-adapter/specs/document-generation-vendor-adapter/spec.md#requirement-a-render-is-a-typed-command-with-a-tracked-job-req-dgv-002.

sourceId.title: Source
sourceId.description: The document generation source this render went through

providerId.title: Provider
providerId.description: The binding that served the render: log, smartdocuments or xential

templateId.title: Template
templateId.description: The vendor's own template id. Integriq stores no copy of the template itself

dataHash.title: Data hash
dataHash.description: sha256 over the canonicalised merge data. The data itself is never stored here

requestedBy.title: Requested by
requestedBy.description: The user the render was made for

requestedByApp.title: Requested by app
requestedByApp.description: The app that asked, normally filinq

status.title: Status
status.description: queued: the vendor took it. rendered: a document came back and was fetched whole. failed: the vendor answered no. unreachable: nobody got an answer, so nobody knows yet whether a document exists

providerJobId.title: Vendor job id
providerJobId.description: The vendor's own render id, when it named one

fileReference.title: Document reference
fileReference.description: The reference to the produced document. Empty unless the job is rendered

documentBytes.title: Document size
documentBytes.description: The size of the fetched document. A render reported done with nothing to fetch is never filed as rendered

lastError.title: Last error
lastError.description: Why the vendor refused. Empty for every status other than failed

unreachableSince.title: Unreachable since
unreachableSince.description: When the vendor stopped answering about this render. Empty once anybody hears back

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: One entry per call: when, what came back, and the detail

objects.name: SmartDocuments
objects.description: SmartDocuments document generation, reached by filinq as a template backend (ADR-075). Ships in mock mode so the path works without a licence: three fixture templates and a fixture document, no network call and no credential. To go live: set `configuration.mockMode` to false, set `configuration.baseUrl` to your SmartDocuments API, register the API key with the OpenRegister credential broker and reference it from `configuration.authentication.credentialRef`. An API key written into this source is refused.
